body:
Source: repo-bloat review (rev-tests finding 1 & 2, issue #1043). `packages/runner/test/cli-exit-codes.test.mjs`, `codex-integration.test.mjs`, and `runner.test.mjs` manually invoke `mkdtempSync` and guard removals in 31 `try/finally` blocks (or leak temporary directories without cleanup), and are allowlisted in `scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs`. With `@adlc/core/test-kit` (`tmp`, `gitRepo`), fixture directories automatically register cleanup via `t.after` when passed the test context `t`.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. In `packages/runner/test/cli-exit-codes.test.mjs`:
   - Import `{ tmp }` from `@adlc/core/test-kit`.
   - Update test declarations to accept the `t` parameter.
   - Update `tmpAdlc(t)` to take `t` and create the directory via `tmp(t, 'adlc-runner-cli-')`.
2. In `packages/runner/test/codex-integration.test.mjs`:
   - Import `{ tmp }` from `@adlc/core/test-kit`.
   - Update tests creating temporary directories to accept `t` and use `tmp(t, prefix)`.
   - Remove manual `try { ... } finally { rmSync(...); }` blocks, unindenting the test bodies.
3. In `packages/runner/test/runner.test.mjs`:
   - Import `{ tmp, gitRepo }` from `@adlc/core/test-kit`.
   - Update tests creating temporary directories or scratch git repos to accept `t`.
   - Update `tmpAdlc(t)` to take `t` and create the directory via `tmp(t, 'adlc-runner-')`.
   - Remove all manual `try { ... } finally { rmSync(...); }` blocks, unindenting the test bodies.
4. In `scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs`:
   - Remove `'packages/runner/test/cli-exit-codes.test.mjs'`, `'packages/runner/test/codex-integration.test.mjs'`, and `'packages/runner/test/runner.test.mjs'` from the `ALLOWLIST` set.
5. Verification:
   - `npm test -w packages/runner` exits 0 with all 143 tests passing.
   - `node --test scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs` exits 0.
   - `grep -c 'finally' packages/runner/test/cli-exit-codes.test.mjs packages/runner/test/codex-integration.test.mjs packages/runner/test/runner.test.mjs` outputs 0, 0, 0.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 `grep -c 'finally' packages/runner/test/cli-exit-codes.test.mjs packages/runner/test/codex-integration.test.mjs packages/runner/test/runner.test.mjs` reports 0, 0, 0.
- AC2 `grep -E 'packages/runner/test/' scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs` returns nothing.
- AC3 `npm test -w packages/runner` exits 0 with all tests passing.
- AC4 `node --test scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs` exits 0.
- AC5 `adlc rails-guard` exits 0.
title: refactor(runner): adopt @adlc/core/test-kit and eliminate 31 try/finally blocks and manual cleanup in runner tests
